registered_algorithm.name: generic exact modular cube residue filter + numpy sorted two-sum search; source-derived RHS, NEVER labels or stored external witness
registered_algorithm.for_any_target: Check original source authentic and has one exact assertion sum of THREE Int symbolic cubes equals an Int constant; use actual z3 parsed AST to verify source equation is that form. If not, ABSTAIN.
registered_algorithm.residue_filter: Enumerate r in Z/9 for variable cubes, cube value modulo9 in {-1,0,1}; permit only residue-triplets whose cube values sum to actual original target modulo9; filter integer candidates by full allowed per (x,y) then derive admissible z residue. Use no conjectural universal identity beyond finite exhaustive modulo9 certified cases.
registered_algorithm.integer_domain: fixed symmetric [-10000,10000], bisection deterministic, sorted 64-bit cubes exact with 2K+1 <= 20001; no overflow because abs(x)^3 <= 10^12
registered_algorithm.work_bound: candidate numeric complete for radius 10000, no genuine SAT iff no bounded witness is found; do not claim original unsat from finite search
registered_algorithm.verification: If numeric candidate found, recheck full exact original source assert with Z3 and independent pinned cvc5 after grounding x,y,z, require both SAT; no source mutation or test-time teacher labels.
registered_algorithm.negative_controls: wrong candidate near genuine 228 witness must be rejected by dual proof, syntax mutation and original Git source mismatches should ABSTAIN
registered_algorithm.first_vs_future: Original STC0228 development proof posthoc; other 7 are prospective source-body-unopened transfer of fixed mod9 and 10k search algorithm. No tuning based on future results.
registered_algorithm.claim_limit: No algorithmic novelty of elementary modular arithmetic or meet-in-middle; only source-specific exact certificates and bounded first-transfer utility. No full Q3/Q4/10x or neural discovery assertion.
